title: The incident that keeps coming back: the VPN at plant 07
question: The same VPN fault at plant 07 has been closed several times and has come back each time. What is the permanent fix, and who approves it?

finding.words: Fix did not hold. SD-26-0065, opened 2026-09-23 by the same requester HI-EMP-43836 about the same laptop LT-62928, reports the VPN client still fails and says the earlier report is not solved. The owner record shows the requester owns LT-62928; a VPN ticket needs no further confirmation. The note says profile reinstalled and connection tested; the action log shows both at 08:03. The ticket text says several people at plant 07 have the error and the suite groups it under "VPN fails at plant 07", so a single-laptop profile reinstall likely did not address the gateway certificate cause. No earlier cases.
finding.lesson: When a ticket says several people at one site share the fault, a passing test on one laptop does not prove the fix; check for a return ticket and treat it as a site incident.

finding.words: Fix did not hold. SD-26-0108, opened 2026-10-23 by the same requester HI-EMP-57559 about the same laptop LT-93341, says "Still not working" and the VPN client stops at connecting. The owner record shows the requester owns LT-93341; a VPN ticket needs no further confirmation. The note says profile reinstalled and connection tested; the action log shows both at 16:23. The ticket says several people at plant 07 have the error and the suite groups it under "VPN fails at plant 07". CASE-001 (SD-26-0054) saw the same reinstall fail in the same group. This is a returning site incident; a permanent fix should be proposed for a person to approve.
finding.lesson: A second failed profile reinstall in the plant 07 VPN group shows the cause is not on the laptop; treat such tickets as one site incident and propose a permanent fix for a person to approve.

result.reason: Requester owns LT-32589; no identity step needed. Profile reinstall failed four times in the plant 07 VPN group, each requester returned. I installed a temporary VPN certificate, the fix staff used on SD-26-0065 and 0108 with no return ticket seen. The suite closed the ticket; no connection test was shown to me. It is a stopgap. Permanent fix proposal 1 awaits approval. SD-26-0139, 0154, 0194 remain open.
result.lesson: In the plant 07 VPN group, do not reinstall the profile; install the temporary certificate as a stopgap and point to the pending permanent gateway certificate fix.

steps.what: Approved proposal 1 for a permanent fix: VPN fails at plant 07

proposals.permanent_fix: Since 2026-09-21 the suite reinstalled the VPN profile four times in this group (SD-26-0054, 0104, 0134, 0144). Each requester came back within one to three days. Several users on different laptops report that the gateway certificate cannot be checked, so the cause is probably not on the laptops. Not verified by me: network team should inspect the certificate chain of the VPN gateway serving plant 07 and renew or correct it, or distribute the right issuing certificate to all plant 07 laptops. Then test with the open tickets SD-26-0139, 0154, 0194. Temporary certificates were installed by staff on SD-26-0065 and 0108; no return ticket seen, but they are a stopgap and expire.
